scope: Entire stable VS Code 1.141.0 vscode.d.ts; all 16 namespaces and every class/interface/enum/value/signature remain in inventory. Proposed APIs are separately listed, not silently folded into stable.
rules: A method name or constructible DTO is not a passed semantic contract. Qualify individual overloads and fields.
Preserve native operation without a JS runtime; the compatibility process owns extension execution only.
All mutation flows cross typed native transaction gateways with model/group/owner/session/version/policy proofs; no filesystem work in input/render.
Bound actual work, retained original objects, queued intent and normalized results; logical cancellation does not free an occupied callback.
Use pure contract tests, framed host integration and PTY journeys locally; genuine upstream qualification only remotely per current user instruction. Retain all historical raw observations.
Do not raise vscode.version or remove missing-API rejection to suggest compatibility. An explicit unimplemented result remains preferable to silent success.

Treat API surfaces and package/runtime compatibility as separate gates: engine versions, dependencies, Node/Electron assumptions, native binaries, activation events, manifest contributions and marketplace licensing remain explicit.

phases.name: Exact document/editor/workspace gateway and extension boot essentials
features: Complete Position/Range/Selection/Uri/Disposable/events and heavily used exported data types/enums
ExtensionContext storage/log locations, extension metadata, Memento and asynchronous secrets gateway
TextDocument.save/getWordRangeAtPosition and incremental change/save reasons
openTextDocument content/untitled/custom schemes and showTextDocument overloads
Distinct TextEditor handle per exact group membership; selection setter, selections/options/viewColumn/visibleRanges/revealRange/insertSnippet
workspace.applyEdit including guarded multi-document edits and resource operations; complete TextEditorEdit undo/EOL semantics
Configuration.update wired to native persistent writer and target/scope events
Workspace fs/search/watch/resource events and multi-root identity
Environment/clipboard/openExternal/URI handler/localization and original command delegation/execute-provider commands
reuse: editor Groups membership/UI proof and bounded native file-open/save workers
qualification: Actual unchanged language-server extension activation smoke, no fabricated supported APIs
Hidden/shared group handles, edit→Undo stale reply, pending SaveAs owner, URI virtual file and workspace edit no-clobber integrity
Cancellation/error/dispose event order and mutation rejection preserves text/selections/Undo/Redo/disk

phases.name: All language provider families and complete existing provider contracts
features: match/getLanguages/setTextDocumentLanguage/setLanguageConfiguration and full selectors
Completion overloads, insert/replace, commit characters, commands, snippet fields and complete contexts
Rename/prepareRename, range/on-type formatting, implementation/type/declaration and workspace symbols
Semantic tokens, inlay hints, document links/colors and color presentations
Folding/selection/linked editing/call hierarchy/type hierarchy
Document paste/drop providers, related metadata, cancellation and resolver lifetimes
Diagnostic result fields/aggregation/events and signature/hover/definition virtual-resource contracts
reuse: native typed LSP/provider lanes, document mutation staging and Outline/display engines
qualification: Per-provider typed DTO and all overload validation; getter/reentrant/circular data adversaries
Original object resolution identity, owner disable/unload/re-register A→B→A, timeout until actual callback settles
Native clangd and unchanged language extensions through real callbacks, visible editor UX and Undo integrity

phases.name: Complete common window presentation and resource UI APIs
features: Stateful QuickPick/InputBox, multi-selection, buttons, validation, cancellation and message choices/modal overloads
Progress, dialogs, decoration types, themes/icons/color events and accessibility metadata
Complete TreeView/TreeItem/provider reveal/getParent/resolve/multi-select/checkbox/drag-drop
LogOutputChannel and standard output overloads
tabGroups/tab events/editor visible/selection/options/ranges lifecycle
WebviewPanel/WebviewView, custom editors and serializers with isolated HTML/DOM execution where required
reuse: Native modal/keyboard/layout surfaces and extension owner-scoped handles
qualification: Terminal focus/keyboard/mouse and cancellation journeys
Widget/provider disposal while callbacks are held; cross-group view equality does not reauthorize old handle
HTML-dependent surfaces require a real isolated browser-capable adapter; terminal presentation adaptation and API behavior are distinct qualification scopes

phases.name: Tooling workflow APIs connected to native engines
features: Terminal/Pseudoterminal profiles/providers/environment-variable collections and shell integration
Task providers, Shell/Process/CustomExecution, lifecycle/termination and problem matchers
Debug configuration/adapter descriptors/trackers/sessions/breakpoints/variables/console
SourceControl resources/groups/input/quick diffs and repository-owned commands
Test controllers/items/profiles/runs/results/coverage and native discovery/execution
qualification: Process termination retains actual ownership, output and PTY restoration
Native existing task/DAP/git features are not automatically extension API implementations
Multiple providers/projects, cancellation, failure and dispose do not lose dirty models or route to wrong workspace

phases.name: Structured content and review model APIs
features: Notebook serializer/controller/kernel/cells/output/status/edits/events and documents
Comment controllers/threads/replies/reactions/menus and resource identity
Custom/virtual editor persistence, text/content providers and complete file-operation hooks
qualification: Cell/group identity and compound Undo are distinct from plain TextDocument identity
Serializer save receipt and provider waitUntil edits remain bounded and owner-guarded
Round-trip structured bytes, virtual-resource reveal, crash/restart and disposal preserve unsaved content

phases.name: Authentication and modern stable AI APIs
features: Authentication provider/session/request changes and secrets-backed storage
Chat participants/requests/response stream/follow-ups and feedback
Language model selection/chat/tool invocation/token counting and stable MCP/model-provider registrations
Environment telemetry and controlled account/workspace trust integration
qualification: Model/provider/session identities, tokens/secrets, consent callbacks, bounded streams and owner teardown
No invented availability/success for unavailable external service or credential
Current stable API is substantially broader than the older 1.95 host claim; keep latest signatures explicit

phases.name: Whole stable-surface conformance and explicit proposals
features: Close every retained stable declaration/member/overload row with named qualification or documented adaptation
Representative unchanged extension corpus across installed platforms, including dependencies/native binaries
Separately opt-in versioned proposed API contracts; no default proposal exposure
Complete contribution/activation/runtime compatibility inventory and Open VSX/package updates
qualification: Fresh remote headless reference cohorts and native comparisons once feature work is ready
No scalar compatibility percentage: track per-API overload, package and workflow evidence
Terminal cannot manufacture a graphical DOM or intercepted key; isolate appropriate adapter without blocking the native core
